rules.text: IF Time for LOX tank pressure to reach 3.3 bar > 12 s THEN LOX tank under-pressure
IF LOX tank pressure, mean over the countdown < 3.19 bar THEN LOX tank under-pressure
IF LOX tank pressure shortfall vs the reference ramp > 0.095 bar THEN LOX tank under-pressure
IF LOX tank pressure, maximum over the countdown < 3.44 bar THEN LOX tank under-pressure
IF LOX tank pressure, mean over the boosted ascent < 3.41 bar THEN LOX tank under-pressure
IF LH2 tank pressure, standard deviation over the boosted ascent > 0.0141 bar THEN LH2 pressure regulator oscillation
IF LH2 pressure oscillation, strongest 5 s > 0.0146 bar THEN LH2 pressure regulator oscillation
IF LH2 tank pressure oscillation in ascent (RMS) > 0.0109 bar THEN LH2 pressure regulator oscillation
IF LH2 tank pressure oscillation (0.15-0.5 Hz RMS) > 0.0107 bar THEN LH2 pressure regulator oscillation
IF Lowest bus voltage from 2 s after the transfer < 28.1 V THEN Bus voltage sag at power transfer
IF Bus voltage dip at the switch to onboard power > 0.787 V THEN Bus voltage sag at power transfer
IF Avionics bus voltage, minimum over the countdown < 27.3 V THEN Bus voltage sag at power transfer
IF Avionics bus voltage, mean over the countdown < 28.1 V THEN Bus voltage sag at power transfer
IF Chamber pressure at H0 + 2.5 s < 102 bar THEN Slow core engine start
IF Time for chamber pressure to reach 50 % of nominal > 1.88 s THEN Slow core engine start
IF Time for chamber pressure to reach 90 % of nominal > 2.58 s THEN Slow core engine start
IF LOX turbopump speed, mean over the engine start < 72.1 % THEN Slow core engine start
IF Core chamber pressure, mean over the engine start < 82.2 bar THEN Slow core engine start
IF Engine-bay vibration, minimum over the boosted ascent > 1.01 g rms THEN Combustion instability
IF Engine-bay vibration vs the nominal profile, worst 1 s > 1.32 ratio THEN Combustion instability
IF Engine-bay vibration vs the nominal profile, mean > 1.23 ratio THEN Combustion instability
IF Engine-bay vibration, mean over the boosted ascent > 2.02 g rms THEN Combustion instability
IF Chamber pressure roughness (>1.5 Hz RMS) in ascent > 0.46 bar THEN Combustion instability
IF Temperature rise confirmed by a pump speed rise, max > 26.9 K THEN Turbine over-temperature
IF LOX turbopump speed, standard deviation over the boosted ascent > 0.323 % THEN Turbine over-temperature
IF LOX pump speed rise above the pad plateau (max) > 0.686 % THEN Turbine over-temperature
IF Chamber pressure rise above the pad plateau (max) > 0.819 bar THEN Turbine over-temperature
IF Largest turbine temperature jump within 0.2 s > 18.9 K THEN Turbine temperature sensor fault
IF Temperature rise not explained by pump speed (40 K per %), max > 39.9 K THEN Turbine temperature sensor fault
IF Turbine inlet temperature, maximum over the boosted ascent > 1032 K THEN Turbine temperature sensor fault
IF Turbine inlet temperature, standard deviation over the boosted ascent > 13.6 K THEN Turbine temperature sensor fault
IF Correlation of TVC yaw offset with booster imbalance > 0.389 r THEN Booster thrust imbalance
IF Booster chamber pressure imbalance, worst 2 s > 2.64 % THEN Booster thrust imbalance
IF Axial acceleration oscillation 10-20 Hz, worst 5 s > 0.0172 g THEN POGO onset
IF Axial acceleration oscillation 10-20 Hz, late ascent > 0.0135 g THEN POGO onset
IF Chamber pressure oscillation 10-20 Hz, worst 5 s > 0.245 bar THEN POGO onset
IF Chamber pressure roughness, worst 5 s of ascent > 0.359 bar THEN POGO onset
IF Rise of the trajectory deviation against the normal spread over the last 20 s > 0.0465 ratio THEN Trajectory deviation
IF Trajectory deviation growth over the last 5 s > 0.0578 km/s THEN Trajectory deviation
IF Trajectory deviation growth, fastest 5 s so far > 0.0596 km/s THEN Trajectory deviation
IF Rise of the trajectory deviation against the normal spread over 20 s, largest so far > 0.34 ratio THEN Trajectory deviation
IF Trajectory deviation, last 1 s > 3.32 km THEN Trajectory deviation
Turbine temperature sensor fault and Turbine over-temperature were never seen together

actions.label: HOLD
actions.description: Stop the countdown clock (hold) and recycle

actions.label: ABORT
actions.description: Shut the core engine down before booster ignition

actions.label: CRITICAL
actions.description: Alert mission director and flight safety: critical in-flight anomaly

actions.label: WARNING
actions.description: Alert mission director: degraded in-flight performance

actions.label: ADVISORY
actions.description: Flag the sensor as failed; do not act on its redline without corroboration
